title: Chapter 3: The Sea Of ​​Insects Shows Its Power
content:
Chapter 3: The Sea Of ​​Insects Shows Its Power

Wu Qing did not continue to wait at the Zerg base. He grabbed a rare iron gun seized from the green-skinned man and ran to the valley entrance.

Behind him, six terrifying alien insects with more than two meters long, sharp forearms with jagged edges and sharp teeth broke out of their cocoons.

One larva can hatch two puppies, and two puppies only occupy one population unit.

The six puppies shook off the organic mucus on their bodies and ran wildly in the direction of Wu Qing, and soon caught up with Wu Qing.

Wu Qing looked at the six ferocious alien insects. Their strength was not up to level one, but their unique body structure made them the most suitable creatures for killing.

Compared with the green-skinned man, the star-less puppies also have a certain advantage in size.

Wu Qing ordered the puppies to follow him in pairs near him, and he quickly rushed to the valley entrance.

On the way, he met a team of ten green-skinned men who were searching in the valley along the traces he had left.

After Wu Qing's several attacks, the greenskins have gained experience and now they act in groups.

Seven to ten, we can do it!

Wu Qing used himself as bait and suddenly rushed out, stabbing a greenskin with an iron spear.

In the jungle, the trees were everywhere and it was impossible to disperse. The greenskins in front waved sticks and other weapons to attack Wu Qing, cooperating with each other to prevent the agile Wu Qing from getting close.

The greenskins behind shouted for help and went around Wu Qing from both sides, trying to surround him.

Just when the small encirclement of ten greenskins was about to be formed, six terrifying black shadows suddenly rushed out of the forest, two by two, and rushed towards the three greenskins who were entangled with Wu Qing head-on.

The incident happened suddenly, and the greenskins did not expect that Wu Qing, who had been alone, would have helpers. Caught off guard, the three greenskins were thrown to the ground by the puppy without any resistance.

"Ah...!"

The puppy pounced and bit frantically, taking their lives in an instant.

Wu Qing took the opportunity to thrust his spear and stabbed the only remaining greenskin man in the chest who was fighting him head-on.

The greenskin man covered his chest and slowly fell down.

The situation suddenly changed, and the number of people on the battlefield became seven to six.

The six greenskin men who reacted shouted fanatically: "God of the Spirit! Give me strength!" and charged at Wu Qing and the puppy.

The greenskin man's fanaticism was due to faith, while the puppy's madness was instinctive!

Without Wu Qing's command, the puppies roared silently, two by two, and fiercely pounced on the greenskin man.

The puppies ignored the damage they suffered, cooperated with each other, and used their numerical advantage to kill one person first and then besiege the remaining one, instead of fighting the enemy one-on-one.

The battle ended before Wu Qing joined the battle.

Ten greenskin men fell to the ground, and the greenskin men killed by the puppies were all horrible.

The bodies of the greenskin men slowly faded and disappeared.

There are two puppies who are injured, and they are also seriously injured. If they return to the territory to rest, their injuries will slowly recover, but in this situation, they are not allowed to do so.

The greenskins have called more enemies to come.

Wu Qing remotely controls a new larva next to the mother nest to continue hatching puppies.

Now there are enough resources and the population limit is enough, but the speed of larvae cannot keep up.

Wu Qing thought about it, controlled a worker bee to stop mining, consumed 300 energy points, and built another mother nest next to the mother nest.

This is the best solution at present.

Wu Qing led the six puppies to continue moving towards the exit of the valley. On the way, another larva was born in the mother nest and continued to hatch puppies.

When they were about to reach the exit of the valley, another team of greenskins appeared in Wu Qing's field of vision.

Without hesitation, Wu Qing seized the time and followed the same method. At the cost of three puppies being injured, he successfully eliminated this team of greenskins.

At this time, the two puppies hatched in the base caught up, and the other two had also broken their shells and were rushing over.

The newly built nest was also completed, with three larvae attached, plus one larva newly born in the first nest, a total of four larvae, all hatched into puppies, and eight puppies were obtained.

After the greenskins found that the team in the valley did not respond, they became cautious and no longer entered the valley in batches, but gathered at the entrance of the valley.

Seeing that the greenskins at the entrance of the valley were gathering more and more, Wu Qing sent out the four newly arrived puppies, crossed the valley from the side, in groups of two, to harass and confuse the greenskin team that was rushing to gather.

Wu Qing took the six puppies who had fought two battles to rest in place.

The Zerg territory kept changing. Under the joint action of the two nests, the organic spread like a carpet covered a large area.

Because of Wu Qing's request, the nest did not absorb the trees in the territory, and these trees could provide a certain amount of cover for the newly born Zerg territory.

Eight puppies broke out of the chrysalis and rushed to Wu Qing's position.

Wu Qing discovered that although a mother nest can only support three larvae at the same time, the speed of new birth is very fast, and one larva can be produced in about one minute, which is enough in the real world.

Before the eight puppies ran to Wu Qing, two larvae were born in the base, and then the puppies were hatched.

In this way, until the population limit was reached, Wu Qing consumed 100 energy points and a larva to hatch a host that could increase the population limit by eight.

The host is huge in size, with thick skin and flesh, can fly in the air, can resist invisibility, and can be loaded and transported. It is one of the most important units of the Zerg.

The host has no attacking ability in the game, but the Zerg uses it as the core to control the entire swarm, which shows its strong spiritual power.

The appearance of the host has strengthened the collective consciousness of the entire swarm.

The harassment and confusion strategy of the four puppies sent by Wu Qing has taken effect. The greenskins gathered at the entrance of the valley have not entered the valley for a long time, and many of the greenskins who are rushing to the valley have been led to other directions by the four puppies.

This gave Wu Qing time to accumulate troops calmly.

When the number of puppies around Wu Qing reached 30, the energy was almost consumed, and Wu Qing took the initiative to attack the greenskins gathered at the entrance of the valley.

30 puppies shuttled rapidly in the forest and launched a fierce attack on the greenskins who had gathered to a scale of about 50 people!

There is no open and flat place in the forest, and there are many trees in the gathering place of the greenskins. These trees separate them and prevent them from gathering into formation to fight the enemy.

This gave the puppies, who were at an absolute disadvantage in number, an opportunity.

The puppies, who are good at using their numbers to siege, are divided into two teams and attack from the left and right directions of the greenskins' gathering place at the same time.

They separated several greenskins and rushed forward, completely disregarding their own casualties and forcibly killing the target, which was extremely fierce.

After killing the target, they cooperated with the counterattack to separate other greenskins, cutting and eating the greenskins from the gathering square piece by piece like cutting a cake.

Even the greenskins with firm beliefs were frightened in the face of such a crazy fighting method, and their courage was weakened a little bit.

Among the assembled greenskins, there were three cavalrymen riding on big lizards. They shouted the names of gods and slogans to boost the morale of the combat team, which strengthened the greenskins' fighting spirit and made the counterattack more powerful and effective.

The greenskins' big sticks were not for show. With a hard stick, the puppies, who were not even at the first level, could not bear it.

For the first time, the puppies died. The damage suffered by many puppies had reached the critical point, and the number of 30 puppies was quickly reduced to 15.

But the Greenskins suffered even greater casualties, and only about twenty Greenskins who survived and were still able to fight were left.

The individual Zerg is just an extension of the collective consciousness of the Zerg, and has no independent consciousness. It is equivalent to a small part of the Zerg collective, just like humans cutting their nails and hair, which has no effect on the Zerg itself.

Wu Qing used the Zerg without any psychological burden. As long as there are enough resources, just do it!

The remaining puppies fought to the death, killing the Greenskins and roaring, calling for reinforcements.

Two more teams of Greenskins got rid of the harassment of the puppies and rushed to join the battlefield.

The wounded puppies were eventually outnumbered and all died on the spot.

The Greenskin Knight wanted to come and see what the puppies were. The bodies of the puppies and the Greenskins on the battlefield instantly became illusory and drifted away with the wind.

"God of the Spirit!"

The Greenskins who saw this scene all bowed their heads in fear and prayed to the gods.

Wu Qing stood not far away and watched all this silently. Behind him, pairs of puppies kept joining in, and soon formed a large group.

"Attack!"

The puppies that had just gathered rushed towards the green man who was praying like a tide.
